title: flat and good for travel.
text: flat and good for travel.. Bought these for travel... they lay flat... the are fairly light weight.  The rubber placement does keep things on the hanger better than just smooth plastic or wood.  I don't hang my pants across the bottom but there is a rubber strip there if you do.  I think they will wear fairly well, however, I will update if there are any wear issues.  They arrived quickly (I have prime) and in good condition.
